title: HADOOP-18022. Add restrict-imports-enforcer-rule for Guava Preconditions and remove remaining usages
category: feature
requirement: '## Context

  Hadoop is standardizing on a build rule that forbids Guava Preconditions, but the remaining usages span several subsystems and some of them have externally observed validation behavior. Maintainers need the dependency cleanup without changing how invalid inputs are reported.


  ## Desired outcome

  Add the restrict-imports-enforcer-rule for Guava Preconditions at the build level and replace the remaining usages with equivalent local checks. Existing validation contracts should remain intact, including clear NullPointerException messages such as "context shouldn''t be null", "data to retrieve shouldn''t be null", "clusterId shouldn''t be null", "DoAsUser shouldn''t be null", and "entityType shouldn''t be null" where those checks already matter.


  ## Acceptance signals

  The build rejects new Guava Preconditions imports, the touched modules compile without that dependency, and callers still receive the same style of null-validation failures from the affected APIs.

  '
